notes.title: Summer is over, the next MasterShot VR update is finally here!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28348022/808608fd1fea514bfeff7980e4358450ad7ccc67.png[/img]

It's been several weeks of development hell for us, but the result should be worth it.

We've upgraded to Unity 2017 and should be benefiting from all the new features and performance improvements. We've ditched the elevator and now each challenge is a scene of it's own. We've settled on a new post-apo motif and will be sticking with it throughout from here. Also added is a new night fight level and a new gun with flashlight attachment to go with it. We also will be building out the new Wasteland Saloon basecamp to have mini games and other features.

Now that we have this stronger foundation and focus, what comes next is all about more over-the-top single and multi-player challenges.

Cheers,

notes.title: Multiplayer and live firing ranges are here!
notes.notes:
It almost killed us, but we finally managed to get multiplayer stable and working. Two live firing ranges are up for you to test now. You will be able to voice chat with your opponent and agree on a challenge. Be patient as we need many more users for everyone to get matched!!! 

That said this is a big feature upgrade for us. Co-op mode with rescuing survivors etc is now very doable. Zombies now have basic path finding and will soon have some rudimentary ai. This plus the new explosive props make the single player levels more fun also. Obstacles are coming very shortly.

Here again: as we now have a solid foundation in place we'd love to see your videos, streams and suggestions, we'll be quick to implement.

There will be at least one hot fix this week most likely.

Thanks so much for playing!

notes.title: Thanks again for giving us a shot / new update v 1.1.81
notes.notes:
Hi there,

thanks to everyone giving us a shot. As promised we are listening to all comments and pushing out updates.

From here on out the exe will be named MasterShotVR. So this once (sorry!) we shall make everyone download a big file for update from here on out updates will be much quicker.

We upgraded to Unity 5.6.1 and the zombies, shadows etc should look better now.

Within the next few days expect an update with obstacles, props and explosions.

Fixes for this version:

- level 13 issue is fixed
- to the user who had an immediate 'out of ammo' please reach out with log file we can't recreate
- small fixes and polish

Cheers and look for next update with faster download in the next 4 days!

notes.title: Master Shot VR is finally live!
notes.notes:
Hi,

After much delay we have finally managed to go live. It's an early access title so expect lots of very granular updates. We are adding to the experience to bring out the 'tv show' aspect more. And of course more explosions, guns and different types of attackers.

Please reach out we love community input. If you'd like to see specific features point them out, we'll answer.

Cheers,

Daniel Burns
Puresurface Inc. / BIG3D
